title: Authority-kernel mutation sentinels
failure_injections: aggregate irrelevant extra-role UNKNOWN into a weaker claim
treat authentic but claim-irrelevant evidence as usable witness support
accept circular claim-to-claim support as grounded
acceptance: Every declared mutant class must be killed by at least one deterministic sentinel test on the normative authority path.
invariants: Passing Tests != Tested Invariants unless plausible mutants are explicitly challenged
Regression tests should encode previously observed or high-likelihood authority failures
Mutation sentinels belong outside the authority kernel; they test the kernel rather than participate in claim acceptance
boundary: This is a hand-selected mutation corpus, not exhaustive mutation testing. Surviving unknown mutants remain possible.
